Source record: docs/studies/analysis/parb_gateway_control_history_20260929.md.
Copied Arbitrum gateway discovery and historical permission
audit
Research date: 29 September 2026. This study checks historical gateway discovery and permissions at
the recorded ARB and GRT issuance dates. All operations were public reads. The endpoint is PulseChain
block 27,659,393, hash 0xc5e582cd902f4bff3b1aa325b9b564fcd5d6dc0ffa77a03fcd105b65c6390275. The inherited
snapshot is 17,232,999; post-fork history begins at 17,233,000.
Findings
GRT's minter permission and the implementation that later executed its mint were installed
before the fork, in the same April 2023 transaction. The selected GRT ownership, minter and
proxy-event histories return no post-fork changes through the endpoint. ARB's configured authorized
gateway also matches at the inherited snapshot, immediately before its recorded mint, and endpoint.
These findings establish inherited issuance permissions for the recorded mints; they do not establish
human ownership of the contracts or source-chain backing.
Equal implementation snapshots do not exclude temporary upgrades. The custom gateway
changed implementation and restored its previous implementation on 1 March 2025. Historical execution
must therefore be checked for each transaction. No selected custom-gateway withdrawal falls in that
interval.
Historical gateway discovery
The prior router census contains 167 GatewaySet logs covering 129 token addresses and ten distinct
nonzero, non-sentinel gateway addresses over its history. Nine remain selected in the endpoint
inventory; the tenth is the retired LPT gateway. This update additionally checks the router's exact
verified DefaultGatewayUpdated(address) event, rather than assuming token-specific registration events
include default changes.
The full-range default query returned one receipt-verified event, at block 13,469,475, 22 October
2021 20:08:00 UTC, setting 0xa3a7b6f88361f48403514059f1f16c8e78d60eec as the default. That address is
already in the inventory. Default-setting transaction.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 75

The default getter returns that same gateway at all four sampled blocks below. This adds no eleventh
gateway. It closes the selected default-change-event gap, not a universal discovery problem: other
routers, direct gateway integrations and contracts absent from the searched event history remain
outside this census. The verified router initializer assigns its initial default without this event; therefore
event enumeration alone is not claimed to reconstruct every initialization state. The inherited getter
anchors the post-fork interval.
GRT: the actual permission grant
At block 17,018,223, 10 April 2023 13:54:59 UTC, the same successful transaction records:
GraphProxy ImplementationUpdated from 0x2bc65e92b68560851c225459a31df6617448ec31 to 
0xd41ca6a1d034d178c196dfa916f22f7d1a1b8222.
Clearance of the pending implementation.
GraphT oken MinterAdded for gateway 0x01cdc91b0a9ba741903aa3699bf4ce31d6c5cc06.
Recorded grant and implementation activation.
GraphT oken's verified source makes mint conditional on isMinter(caller). Its permission events are 
MinterAdded(address) and MinterRemoved(address). The GRT proxy uses ImplementationUpdated(address,address), 
PendingImplementationUpdated(address,address) and AdminUpdated(address,address); looking only for
OpenZeppelin's Upgraded(address) would miss its history. GraphT oken source, GraphProxy source.
The specialized-control batch returned 30 receipt-verified events, all inherited: eleven selected GRT-
token ownership/minter events, seven GRT proxy events, six WETH proxy events, two wstETH proxy
events, two ARB gateway proxy events and two ARB token proxy events. The other selected specialized
gateway addresses returned no events for the queried proxy signatures. There were no query errors in
this completed batch. Zero results at direct contracts do not prove those contracts have no other control
mechanism.
This complements the existing GRT allowance reconciliation (Appendix 12): The allowance update is
separately recorded on 18 April 2023, and the later September 2026 issuance used the inherited
permission and allowance formula. The allowance is a token quantity, not an independent measurement
of source collateral or a dollar valuation.
Transaction-time versus endpoint state
Getter-only reads were made at four independently pinned blocks:
Snapshot Block
Inherited 17,232,999
Immediately before the recorded ARB mint block 21,469,489
Immediately before the recorded GRT mint block 27,434,948
Audit endpoint 27,659,393
All twelve sampled EIP-1967 implementation slots match across these points: The router, ten identified
gateways and the ARB token. Four direct gateway contracts have zero in that slot; zero alone is not proof
that no other form of indirection exists. ARB's arbOneGateway() consistently returns 
0xbbce8aa77782f13d4202a230d978f361b011db27; GRT's isMinter(0x01cdc91b0a9ba741903aa3699bf4ce31d6c5cc06)
• 
• 
• 
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 76

consistently returns true. All reads completed without RPC errors. The actual recorded issuance traces
provide the stronger evidence of the implementation used within each mint transaction; predecessor-
block reads alone would miss a same-block change.
The temporary custom-gateway implementation
The completed post-fork router, standard-gateway and custom-gateway proxy and default-event search
returned exactly two receipt-verified events, both at custom gateway 
0xcee284f754e854890e311e3280b767f80797180d:
Date UTC Block Recorded implementation
1 March 2025 20:10:55 22,838,182 0x0750201bf8875a6fdea2ff1a70743c58b
debaf2d
1 March 2025 20:29:25 22,838,289 Restored 
0xc8d26ab9e132c79140b3376a0ac7932e4
680aa45
Upgrade transaction, restoration transaction.
The explorer returned no verified source for the temporary implementation. The six custom-gateway
withdrawal events in the existing census occur outside this 107-block separation. This does not exclude
other calls during the interval. The changed implementation is not classified as an issuer, and no mint is
inferred from the upgrade event itself. The finding demonstrates why endpoint code cannot substitute
for historical traces.
Reproduction and query limitations
Maintained manifests are parb_gateway_control_history_20260929.json, parb_gateway_control_events_20260929.json, 
parb_gateway_specialized_controls_20260929.json and parb_gateway_control_getters_20260929.json. They preserve
the requested scope, narrowed event queries and historical getter specification. No collector or
production application code changed.
Run event manifests with Research/scripts/collect_pulsechain_events.py and a new output path; run the
getter manifest with Research/scripts/probe_pulsechain_routes.py --calls at the four listed blocks. Generated
range-specific execution manifests, raw responses, sources and block hashes are retained under ignored 
artifacts/parb-gateway-control-history-20260929/, with SHA256SUMS.
Some initial full-range router/standard/custom event queries returned truncated JSON. Those failures are
preserved and are not counted as empty results. The full-range specialized query, full-range default
query and complete post-fork router/standard/custom query subsequently succeeded with receipt and
block-hash verification. Partitioned inherited router controls succeeded for blocks 0–13,999,999. One
bounded finer follow-up then successfully covered 15,000,000–17,232,999. Its 14,000,000–14,999,999
query still failed with truncated JSON; this is the remaining inherited-control history gap. No
repeated broad query was attempted in that follow-up. Accordingly this study does not claim a complete
inherited router implementation chronology. The independently successful post-fork query covers the
entire post-fork interval.
The finer pass adds four receipt-verified inherited implementation events: The router, standard gateway
and custom gateway upgraded together at block 15,302,774 on 8 August 2022 17:02:04 UTC; the
router upgraded again at block 15,926,608 on 8 November 2022 16:47:59 UTC. The August standard/
custom implementations match their inherited and endpoint values; the November router
implementation matches its inherited and endpoint value. The two later inherited partitions returned
zero selected events without query errors.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 77

The follow-up uses four explicit manifests, Research/experiments/
parb_gateway_inherited_controls_0_20260929.json through parb_gateway_inherited_controls_3_20260929.json. Fresh
evidence, collector output and the exact failed query diagnostic are preserved under artifacts/parb-
gateway-control-inherited-followup-20260929/ with their own SHA-256 manifest. The original batch and its 53-
file hash manifest were preserved.
The white paper can strengthen its claims about inherited GRT issuance authority and historical address
coverage. It must retain the distinctions between token registration, implementation history, successful
destination issuance and independently verified source backing. No new token-specific mint class was
identified by this control-history audit.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 78
